title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - ComputeFunctionRuntime

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ComputeFunctionRuntime'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

supportedLanguage.description: Property. Language for writing the compute function. Controlled-vocabulary value (ComputeFunctionLanguage), enumeration not resolved in this pass.

supportedVersion.description: Property. Supported version(s) for the runtime language.
